### 2026-10-12 – Today I signed up for onshape and got the free plan.

**1h**

Today I signed up for onshape and got the free plan.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/75a195c283fbd443b5fd0d394239f516e219dd1ed40fa4225965664fcbb7b1ed.png)

The guide seems focused on showing how to use the platform and then I'll have to come up with my own design which is pretty cool. I had to do the obligatory idea reel, so I had to take a few moments to think over what I wanted to do, but I was somewhat unsure so I tried looking in the doomscroller and saw that the guy doing the same project just introduced the project of the week and decided that I should follow a similar format as I wasn't too sure as to what I wanted to do. I did decide on a funnel, as I want to  see the marbles spin around and slowly go into the hole. I thought it would feel satisfying.

### 2026-10-15 – Today I finally finished making an advanced track .

**1h**

Today I finally finished making an advanced track .

I ran into two main issues, when using sweep you MUST make sure there is enough space between the face shape as otherwise, the computer will simply say sweep couldn't work instead of telling you that it can't overlap. In addition, you MUST make sure the face shape, when following the sweep path, won't overlap itself or else it will not work. I spent quite a bit of time trying to fix these issues, but I suppose a positive side to this all is that I've grown much more used to the software. Sadly, my computer is somewhat struggling to handle the load of the software, which makes sense since its old and has an integrated GPU. Hopefully it can cope for long enough for me to complete the actual maze.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/b8347de63c554fd62d790fc2b19b04e74655f68d1ef670d43867ad497737a2d2.png)

Sadly, as I write this, (has this already happened twice? I keep jinxing myself...) my computer refuses to make a new doc, and so I have to resort to deleting all the sketches, etc, in my first doc, which my computer is also coping hard to do so. I plan to make the marble first as the other parts seem like they require quite a bit of time, which I sadly don't have right now.

Wow, the marble kind of looks like a beach ball.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/bf841a97f29092eda8443c887e7e460fb618250e7cf0d46639689035f667607d.png)

I'm rather happy with my progress now, as I feel so much more in tune with this software. I actually know some of the shortcuts like c = center point circle, d = dimension assigner, l = line, m = trim, and I actually use them in a actually useful way.
